summary: withTerminalRenderer default tag uses inv.cwd.split("/").pop() — on win32 the full drive-lettered path renders instead of the worktree name. Use platform basename (src/Agent.ts:275).

edit.description: Default tag: basename(inv.cwd) || "tick" via node:path — mirrors chain.ts fix b248b72.
Assert default tag is the leaf dir for a win32-style backslash cwd (and still for POSIX).

tests.asserts: withTerminalRenderer default tag renders cwd basename under both separator styles

acceptance: pnpm test green; default renderer tag on a drive-lettered cwd is the leaf dir name, not the full path
notes: Audit find off b248b72 (identical bug class, fixed in dogfood chain.ts; this is the src/ echo). Cosmetic (display tag), not fatal.
